limitations: These are preserved authored checks, not new model generations or rewritten assertions.
Only direct literal python3 -c payloads importing solution are replayed; shell expansions and other commands are classified without execution.
Static try/handler and call summaries describe syntax; trace observations establish actual assertion lines and function invocations during replay.
Replay preloads the supplied source as solution; it does not grant model-authored verification credit to a failed captured command.
A check that detects one old failure does not establish full specification coverage or qualification.
Malformed, unsupported, missing instrumentation or truncated outcomes remain unknown; they are not converted into passing checks.
